short: The decisive Allied offensive in Palestine that annihilated three Ottoman armies and forced the empire's capitulation.
full:
On 19 September 1918, British Empire forces under General Edmund Allenby launched a meticulously planned offensive against Ottoman positions in northern Palestine. Utilizing overwhelming artillery support, air superiority, and rapid cavalry envelopments, Allenby's forces broke through the Ottoman lines on the coastal plain. Within days, three entire Ottoman armies were encircled and destroyed, with tens of thousands of prisoners captured.

The Battle of Megiddo was a masterclass in combined arms warfare and the culmination of the Sinai and Palestine campaign. The collapse of the Ottoman military in the Levant led to a rapid Allied advance into Syria and forced the Ottoman Empire to sign the Armistice of Mudros just over a month later, effectively ending its participation in the war.
